public_rationale: Both institutions had completed concrete milestones before the post: the UN General Assembly adopted an AI resolution, and the Council of Europe committee approved its draft framework convention for submission to ministers. These support Marcus’s modest claim of some progress. They do not establish effective enforcement or prove that these institutions outranked all other contributors.
limitations: Institutional progress is distinct from demonstrated practical effectiveness.
The Council of Europe evidence establishes committee approval, not a convention already adopted or in force.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: There has been genuine progress on global AI governance, led especially by the UN and the Council of Europe.

statement.excerpt: I also urged the world to focus on global AI governance, and am pleased to see some genuine progress in that direction, especially led by the UN and the Council of Europe.
statement.document_title: TED, AI, and the test of time

from_speaker: especially led by the UN and the Council of Europe
our_interpretation: Progress means concrete multilateral agreements or completed negotiating milestones, without requiring demonstrated enforcement or reduced harm.
Especially led by identifies prominent institutional contributions, rather than a measurable ranking against every other organization.
The context compares developments since the previous year's TED. The observation window begins at the start of April 2023, representing that approximate starting month, and ends on publication.
criteria.support_condition: Official records show substantive AI-governance milestones at both the UN and the Council of Europe during the contextual period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Official records show that the purported milestones had not occurred by publication or amounted only to unadvanced proposals.
